# SWARAJYA INFOTECH

> SWARAJYA INFOTECH is a premier software development and enterprise IT engineering company headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India. We architect custom enterprise software, cloud web applications, native and cross-platform mobile apps, industrial ERP & CRM systems, barcode/RFID billing & inventory software, and autonomous business process automation with 100% source code ownership and zero recurring user licenses.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://swarajyainfotech.in/custom-software-development.html): Bespoke desktop, cloud, and distributed software engineered around proprietary business logic, factory workflows, and multi-tenant security. Pricing starts from ₹45,000 with 100% private Git repository transfer.
- [Web Application Development](https://swarajyainfotech.in/web-application-development.html): High-speed, responsive cloud web applications, SaaS platforms, vendor portals, and B2B wholesale platforms with sub-1.2s average load speeds and Lighthouse > 95. Pricing starts from ₹25,000.
- [Mobile App Development](https://swarajyainfotech.in/mobile-app-development.html): Native Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift), and cross-platform Flutter mobile applications featuring offline-first SQLite databases, camera barcode scanning, and real-time cloud sync. Pricing starts from ₹35,000.
- [ERP & CRM Solutions](https://swarajyainfotech.in/erp-crm-solutions.html): Tailor-fit manufacturing ERP, shop floor routing, BOM allocation, sales CRM pipelines, and two-way Tally Prime API bridges with zero monthly user taxes. Pricing starts from ₹60,000.
- [Billing & Inventory Software](https://swarajyainfotech.in/billing-inventory-software.html): Multi-warehouse stock control, bin allocation, QR code & thermal barcode printing, active RFID gates, and instant GST e-Way bills. Pricing starts from ₹18,000.
- [Automation & API Integration](https://swarajyainfotech.in/automation-integration.html): Native microservice middleware connecting WhatsApp Business API, Razorpay webhooks, courier logistics APIs, and weighbridge RS-232 telemetry. Pricing starts from ₹20,000.

## Proprietary Software Products

- **School & Institute ERP**: Student information system, RFID student attendance, automated fee collection, exam report cards, and parent mobile app.
- **Manufacturing Shop Floor ERP**: Multi-level Bill of Materials (BOM), stage-wise job cards, contractor inward/outward challans, and real-time machine downtime tracking.
- **Resort & Hotel Management Suite**: Online room reservations, front-desk POS billing, restaurant KOT management, and automated guest WhatsApp check-in.
- **Hospital & Clinic Management System**: Electronic Medical Records (EMR), OPD/IPD billing, digital doctor prescriptions, pharmacy inventory, and lab report delivery.
- **B2B Wholesale & eCommerce Suite**: Dynamic catalog management, multi-tier dealer pricing, GST tax computation, and automated order-to-dispatch pipelines.
